subject: Coordination: MAP & test-case handoff for BrightRetail trial
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Clara Zhou <c.zhou@brightretail.com>, BrightRetail Procurement <procurement@brightretail.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coordination: MAP & test-case handoff for BrightRetail trial

Hi Clara / BrightRetail team,

Thanks again for committing to the pilot. Attached are: 1) a draft mutual action plan (MAP-BrightRetail-draft-20270314.docx) that outlines milestones through pilot close, and 2) a ZIP with the initial test suite (BR-TESTCASES-v1.zip).

Quick asks so we can proceed this week:
- Confirm the usage constraints: we propose "ephemeral sandbox" only (no redistribution, no production ingestion), retention limited to 30 days, and no commercial scoring outside BrightRetail.
- Let us know if you require additional redaction/pseudonymization before transfer.
- Please confirm a single procurement contact for paperwork (we included procurement@brightretail.com on this thread).

Target close: to meet your pilot go/no-go we'd like MAP signed and testcases provisioned by 2027-03-25. If that timing works, we'll send a DocuSign for the MAP + a short asset-handback appendix.

Attachments: BR-TESTCASES-v1.zip (sample testcases), MAP-BrightRetail-draft-20270314.docx

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call if helpful.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

From: Clara Zhou <c.zhou@brightretail.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 13:45:12 -0400
Subject: Re: Coordination: MAP & test-case handoff for BrightRetail trial

Hi Aditya,

Thanks — we got the attachments. A few quick questions from our side:
1) Will the testcases include any PII? If so, can you provide a redacted set?
2) We need to confirm whether the sandbox keys will be tied to contract terms (e.g., limited by token counts).
3) Procurement asks for a version of the MAP that labels which deliverables are "ephemeral" vs "archival".

Procurement: procurement@brightretail.com (CC'd) — can you confirm timing on paperwork?

Clara
Product Ops Manager, BrightRetail

----
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:20:34 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Coordination: MAP & test-case handoff for BrightRetail trial

Monica, Vivek — forwarding Clara's questions plus the attachments. My suggested answers below before we respond to external:

> On Sun, Mar 14, 2027 at 13:45 Clara Zhou <c.zhou@brightretail.com> wrote:
> 
> "1) Will the testcases include any PII? If so, can you provide a redacted set?"

- The attached BR-TESTCASES-v1.zip is an anonymized set (no direct PII). We should explicitly state that we certify testcases are pseudonymized. If legal wants a redaction report, we can generate a short compliance memo.

> "2) We need to confirm whether the sandbox keys will be tied to contract terms (e.g., limited by token counts)."

- Recommend: issue token-limited ephemeral eval keys (API keys scoped to dev environment) with a 30-day TTL and soft token cap aligned to pilot sizing. This satisfies both security and cost predictability.

> "3) Procurement asks for a version of the MAP that labels which deliverables are 'ephemeral' vs 'archival'."

- Propose to add a one-page appendix that marks: testcases = ephemeral (30d retention), MAP + acceptance criteria = archival (retained for contract lifecycle), and log exports = archived per customer retention policy only upon explicit request.

I'm attaching a quick redline I prepared (redlines-BR-terms.pdf) — please review for wording on redistribution, retention, and allowed use.

Two asks:
- Monica: quick legal/ops review of the redlines and appendix language — can you review by EOD 3/16?
- Vivek: confirm we can provision token-limited keys and automated takedown 30 days after handoff.

If both are green, I'll reply to Clara with consolidated answers and the DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Aditya

----
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:08:56 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Coordination: MAP & test-case handoff for BrightRetail trial

Thanks for the draft redlines, Aditya — overall looks good. A few suggested changes before we send externally (high level):

- Explicitly prohibit redistribution and sub-licensing in MAP section 3.2; add a clause prohibiting publishing or sharing of raw testcases outside of the evaluating BrightRetail team.
- Include watermarking guidance for testcases (we can embed a metadata field in the ZIP manifest; call it "ephemeral-id").
- For keys: yes, we can issue token-limited eval keys (API tokens scoped to the deal) and enforce a 30-day TTL with automated revocation. Add a line that keys are for evaluation only and revocation is at Redwood's discretion for misuse.
- Retention: change language to "default 30 days; requires written request for extension; any extension must be mutually agreed and logged in HubSpot."

Timeline: pilot kickoff still looks like end-of-month for BrightRetail. To align with their launch, propose we mark MAP signature target = 2027-03-22, provisioning by 2027-03-24, acceptance window ends 2027-04-07.

I'll attach an internal draft with the edits and loop Legal if procurement pushes on broader terms. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/BR-2027-0421 — please add any internal notes there.

-Monica
Director, Solutions Operations | Redwood Inference

----
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Clara Zhou <c.zhou@brightretail.com>, BrightRetail Procurement <procurement@brightretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordination: MAP & test-case handoff for BrightRetail trial

Clara / procurement team — thanks for the quick turnaround and questions. Below is the consolidated plan and next steps. Please confirm by 2027-03-22 so we can meet pilot timelines.

1) Asset contents and PII: BR-TESTCASES-v1.zip is pseudonymized; Redwood will produce a short redaction memo attesting to no direct identifiers. If BrightRetail requires further redaction, we can produce a sanitized subset prior to transfer.

2) Usage constraints (final):
- Allowed: internal evaluation only by BrightRetail staff named in the MAP; integration testing to validate pilot metrics allowed in the sandbox environment.
- Disallowed: redistribution, sub-licensing, publication of raw cases, training of customer production models outside the pilot, and sale of the dataset.
- Retention: default 30 days from provisioning; extensions permitted only by written mutual agreement and will be logged in HubSpot.
- Watermarking & provenance: testcases will include an "ephemeral-id" manifest field; we will retain an audit trail of key issuance and takedown.

3) Keys & provisioning:
- Redwood will issue token-limited, deal-scoped eval API keys with a 30-day TTL and automated revocation. We will share provisioning instructions once the MAP is signed.

4) Timeline (proposed):
- MAP sign target: 2027-03-22
- Testcase provisioning: 2027-03-24
- Evaluation window: through 2027-04-07

Next steps:
- Clara/procurement: please confirm acceptance of the above and provide the procurement contact who will sign. We will send the DocuSign link for the MAP + asset appendix. DocuSign (preview): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?d=abcdef123456
- If any of the constraints are a blocker, tell us what you'd like changed and we can propose alternative language.

Attachments: redlines-BR-terms.pdf (internal redline we incorporated), BR-TESTCASES-v1.zip (sample set).

Looking forward — we can also schedule a 20-min sync next week if helpful.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
